description: This file defines the 'resmap' package, including interfaces and types for managing collections of Kubernetes resources within the kustomize tool. It includes definitions for resource maps, transformers, generators, and plugin helpers, along with detailed method signatures for resource manipulation and querying.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Interface for modifying a ResMap, e.g., adding labels.

classes.name: TransformerWithProperties
classes.description: Contains a Transformer and stores its properties, including origin.

classes.name: GeneratorWithProperties
classes.description: Contains a Generator and stores its properties, including origin.

classes.name: Configurable
classes.description: Interface for components that accept plugin helpers and YAML config.

classes.name: PluginHelpers
classes.description: Holds dependencies and configuration for plugins, such as loader, validator, factory, and plugin config.

classes.name: GeneratorPlugin
classes.description: Combines Generator and Configurable interfaces for plugin implementations.

classes.name: TransformerPlugin
classes.description: Combines Transformer and Configurable interfaces for plugin implementations.

classes.name: ResMap
classes.description: Interface for managing a collection of Kubernetes resources, including methods for adding, removing, querying, and transforming resources.

methods.name: NewPluginHelpers
methods.description: Creates a new PluginHelpers instance with provided loader, validator, factory, and plugin config.
